title: HDB Flats Sold Under Open Booking Scheme
what_it_is: HDB Flats Sold Under Open Booking Scheme

sections.label: Open booking flat figures
sections.summary: As of 22 February 2021, 1,521 flats have been booked under open booking, with HDB suspending open booking twice yearly to inject fresh supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As of 22 February 2021, a total of 1,521 flats, comprising 46 2-room Flexi flats, 273 3-room flats, 601 4-room flats, 597 5-room/3Gen flats, and four Executive flats, have been booked under open booking.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: At present, HDB suspends open booking twice a year to inject a fresh supply of flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The majority of flats offered under open booking comes from the pool of flats that remain unselected after the twice-yearly Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, since February 2020, HDB has ceased the Re-Offer of Balance Flats exercises, so that more of the unselected flats from the SBF exercises can be offered directly for open booking.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will continue to refine its sales processes to better meet the needs of home seekers.
